versions.changelog:
Initial release of scarf-designer for generating AI-powered custom scarf designs.

- Generate customized scarf designs for print on demand (POD) and manufacturing on demand (MOD).
- Supports natural language prompts, structured parameters, reference images, custom text, and logos.
- Provides interactive 3D viewers and multi-view design generation.
- Allows integrated workflow from concept to manufacturable assets.
- Requires DEEPNLP_ONEKEY_ROUTER_ACCESS for API access.
